mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (payment_no, source_account_id, destination_account_id, amount, currency, reference, status, version) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{sourceAccountId}, #{destinationAccountId}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{reference}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM payment WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.id AS payment_id, p.payment_no, p.source_account_id, src.name AS source_account_name, p.destination_account_id, dst.name AS destination_account_name, p.amount, p.currency, p.status, p.created_at FROM payment p LEFT JOIN account src ON src.id = p.source_account_id LEFT JOIN account dst ON dst.id = p.destination_account_id
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
